form_name: Behind the thread: chat, scripts, raids

cells.how: In form B the lines restrict the stepping-away element: where a member left, the reason given was the room's scripts or an ideology (r/placecanada, r/EraseThePlace), not strain, and attempts to repair a quarrel are seen without their outcome.
In form B scripts are run as shared tools: targets and versions are kept in step so that friendly bots do not undo one another, and a script's fault is fixed without changing its target.

In form B the chat works only on conditions: invitations that work and a current plan members can find; in r/reddevils a member approved the running script while refusing the chat, and the chat's own decisions stay unseen.

In form B sparing passes through the room's tools: an instruction to spare agreed space must reach script users as a target update, a requested template carries a restoration attempt, and admitted script damage brings apology and repair without an attack call.

In form B border talk has steps before and after it: members ask for a treaty before any damage, seek local consensus before a proposal, tell organized allies from hostile placers, and relay a negotiated move to builders by private message and announcement.

In form B a settled border is kept where its terms reach the placers: restraint follows where placers learned of the agreement and where script targets were updated, and a memorial is spared with no border settled.

In form B the record does not show a call's builders turning on a rival: in 7 of the 18 lines the attack call is the first call or shares the opening turn with recruitment, inside A15's bound, and in 11 the lines show the order of the calls but not that the same recruited hands attacked.

changes.how: Starting and calling can coincide in one opening rather than requiring distinct sequential turns.
Keeping existing pixels can overlap initial construction rather than wait for the entire display to be completed.
Changed targets must reach relevant placers through accessible public images when the planning chat is unavailable.
Repairers need a visible revised goal to distinguish intended changes from an invasion they would otherwise repair away.
Apply demonstrated mistaken restoration without inferring eventual loss or abandonment when unreached keepers' outcomes remain unobserved.
Chat coordination reaches willing contributors only when its goals also become accessible to people unable to use the chat.
A member also asks the public thread to carry a relocation proposal into chat, making the relay bidirectional.
Distinguish reported event-channel arrivals from artwork-driven subreddit discovery and lasting membership conversion.
A short redirect is created to make the game findable, while actual discovery through that route remains unmeasured.
Independent visual maintenance can continue without participation in any coordination channel.
Bargaining during conflict is visible, while separate attack posts cannot be assigned as the cause of those negotiations.
The observed assent supports a written response without testing normative obligation, refusal preferences, or silent placement answers.
Applying inherited lore to a canvas opponent does not establish a pre-canvas relationship that selected that opponent.
Overnight coverage is an explicit automation rationale, while the proposed manual-capacity threshold remains unmeasured.
Host complaints concern event content broadly and do not isolate recruitment calls as the sole cause of the flood.
The evidence establishes a participant's stated motive and claimed assistance, without independent pixel measurement or evidence of collective host opposition.
Recording can accompany construction when a timelapse is shared before later pieces are completed.
Recording can be anticipated during construction rather than beginning only after completion and celebration.
A published template settles practical work only as relevant keepers and machine targets become aligned, since uncontacted preservers keep restoring the old form.
Synchronizing a revision includes vetting accounts and directly messaging friendly placers who preserve the superseded design.
Automation makes design synchronization depend on updating machine targets as well as informing human placers.
Updating machine targets includes requesting and supplying a remotely updateable template repository.
Keeping overlaps construction and can interrupt celebration rather than waiting for one definitive completion.
The overrun episode ends in a canceled relocation proposal after reported recovery, so weighing a move must be distinguished from moving.
Restraint remains conditional on reciprocal safety rather than following an agreement uniformly across placers.
Reinterpreting damaged lettering becomes a way to express affection for the shared effort rather than merely mourning its final state.
The event-made spelling joke also supplies the wording of a proposed keepsake without demonstrating that an artifact was produced.
Joining can coexist with negative evaluation and difficulty disengaging rather than expressing unqualified enthusiasm.
Attack and victory sustain talk about an already recognized rival rather than creating the named antagonist from nothing.
Published stopping instructions settle a design only if placers adopt them, since overwrites and difficulty securing agreement persist.
Identifying and privately messaging friendly overwriters attempts to reconcile their actual placing with published redesign instructions.
Telling keepers is not established as sufficient to secure adoption, because dislike and inability to persuade coexist with efforts to inform overwriters.
A proposed peace line must be accepted before it can support settled restraint, since the ship's offer receives an explicit war reply.
Preservation describes participating speakers rather than unanimous attachment, since another participant never expected the letters to last.
An explicit reply turns celebration directly back into maintenance, adding recurrence to the model's stated single order.
A restart invitation demonstrates intended continuation, while site access and usability condition participation and leave the durable outcome unresolved.
Checkerboarding counts as attack when directed against another work, while surrounding the home mark can instead build its canvas.
A hosted-space proposal establishes the request stage without establishing completed hosted work or later host enforcement.
